name: Apprenticeship — DELETE Then Re-POST Same Course, Next AY
description: Commitments approves an apprenticeship (standard 21) entirely within AY 25/26 (StartDate 2025-09-01, EndDate 2026-07-31). SLD/Provider then DELETEs the learner scoped to AY 25/26. Provider then POSTs the same learner onto the same course (standard 21) via the new-style route with academicYear=2627, all dates entirely within AY 26/27 (StartDate 2026-09-01, ExpectedEndDate 2027-07-31). Exercises the interaction between DELETE's academic-year scoping and CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle's GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode) lookup. UNCERTAIN: observed behaviour is that the DELETE removes the AY 25/26 episode outright rather than leaving a removed-but-present row, leaving a single ApprenticeshipLearning with a single episode (StartDate 2026-09-01) after the re-POST. It is not yet established whether this collapse to one learning/one episode is the intended behaviour, or whether the AY 25/26 approved episode should have persisted (removed) alongside a second, independent AY 26/27 row — flag for review before relying on this as the expected contract.

steps.name: Commitments Approves an Apprenticeship, Standard 21, Entirely Within AY 25/26
SLD Removes the Apprenticeship, Scoped to AY 25/26
Wait — inspect DB after deletion, then continue with re-POST
Provider Re-POSTs the Same Learner Onto the Same Course, Standard 21, Entirely Within AY 26/27

assertions.name: Only one ApprenticeshipLearning row exists for the learner
That learning has exactly one episode
The episode's start date matches what was POSTed in AY 26/27
